newsitem.title: USA: Golden Books Q2 loss widens with charge.
newsitem.headline: Golden Books Q2 loss widens with charge.

text.p: Six months ended Aug.3Six months ended July 29
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: The company recorded $80.1 million in restructuring and other charges that impacted 1996 Q2 and six month results. Writedowns in Q2 include a restructuring charge pertaining to a writedown of net assets for the company's Penn Corp unit, a cost-of-sales adjustment for discontinuation and replacement of certain products and the liquidation of related inventory, and a selling and general administrative charge relating to plans to resolve legal and contractual matters
Full company name is Golden Books Family Entertainment Inc.
